newsitem.title: USA: GM unit files for $7.1 bln medium-term notes.
newsitem.headline: GM unit files for $7.1 bln medium-term notes.

text.p: General Motors Acceptance Corp filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for up to $7.125 billion in medium-term notes.
The General Motors financing unit said when combined with a previous registration, it will have up to $10 billion of medium-term notes available for sale.
It said net proceds will be added to its genreal funds and will be available for the purchase of receivables, the making of loans or the repayment of debt.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Salomon Brothers Inc, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Lehman Bros., J.P. Morgan & Co, Bear, Stearns & Co Inc and UBS Securities Inc.
